stem.text: A student makes sodium chloride by reacting together $0.025\ \text{mol}$ of sodium carbonate with an excess of $0.2\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid.
Which statements about the quantities of substance are correct?

items: $600\ \text{cm}^{3}$ of carbon dioxide are produced at room temperature and pressure.
$250\ \text{cm}^{3}$ of the hydrochloric acid are needed to exactly neutralise the sodium carbonate.
